<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_ComputerRepair" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/computer-repair">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DefectiveComputer" name="Defective computer brought in"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairCostCalculation" name="Repair cost calculation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CostsAccepted" name="Costs accepted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CostsRejected" name="Costs rejected"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ComputerRepair">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CRS" name="Computer Repair Service (CRS)" processRef="Process_CRS"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DefectiveComputer" name="Bring in defective computer" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_DefectiveComputer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CostCalculation" name="Repair cost calculation" sourceRef="SendTask_SendCostCalculation" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CostsAccepted" name="Costs accepted" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_CostsAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CostsRejected" name="Costs rejected" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_CostsRejected"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CRS" name="Computer Repair Service" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_DefectiveComputer" name="Defective computer brought in">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_DefectiveComputer" messageRef="Message_DefectiveComputer"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckDefect" name="Check defect"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CalculateRepairCosts" name="Calculate repair costs"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendCostCalculation" name="Send repair cost calculation" messageRef="Message_RepairCostCalculation"/>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="EventGateway_CustomerDecision" name="Customer decision"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_CostsAccepted" name="Costs accepted">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CostsAccepted" messageRef="Message_CostsAccepted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_CostsRejected" name="Costs rejected">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CostsRejected" messageRef="Message_CostsRejected"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ComputerTakenHome" name="Computer taken home unrepaired"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairSplit" name="Start repair"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRepairHardware" name="Check and repair hardware"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestHardware" name="Test hardware functionality"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckConfigureSoftware" name="Check and configure software"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSoftware" name="Test software functionality"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairJoin" name="Repair activities done"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ErrorMerge" name="Merge after test"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ErrorCheck" name="Error detected?" default="Flow_NoError"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FurtherRepair" name="Perform further repair activity"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestAgain" name="Test system functionality"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RepairFinished" name="Repair finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DefectToCheck" sourceRef="StartEvent_DefectiveComputer" targetRef="Task_CheckDefect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckToCalculate" sourceRef="Task_CheckDefect" targetRef="Task_CalculateRepairCosts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CalculateToSend" sourceRef="Task_CalculateRepairCosts" targetRef="SendTask_SendCostCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendToDecision" sourceRef="SendTask_SendCostCalculation" targetRef="EventGateway_CustomerDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DecisionToAccepted" sourceRef="EventGateway_CustomerDecision" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_CostsAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DecisionToRejected" sourceRef="EventGateway_CustomerDecision" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_CostsRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RejectedToEnd" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_CostsRejected" targetRef="EndEvent_ComputerTakenHome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AcceptedToRepairSplit" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_CostsAccepted" targetRef="Gateway_RepairSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToHardware" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckRepairHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToSoftware" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckConfigureSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HardwareToTest" sourceRef="Task_CheckRepairHardware" targetRef="Task_TestHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SoftwareToTest" sourceRef="Task_CheckConfigureSoftware" targetRef="Task_TestSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HardwareTestToJoin" sourceRef="Task_TestHardware" targetRef="Gateway_RepairJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SoftwareTestToJoin" sourceRef="Task_TestSoftware" targetRef="Gateway_RepairJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToErrorMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairJoin" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ErrorMergeToCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ErrorDetected" name="Error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorCheck" targetRef="Task_FurtherRepair">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${errorDetected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoError" name="No error" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorCheck" targetRef="EndEvent_RepairFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FurtherRepairToTest" sourceRef="Task_FurtherRepair" targetRef="Task_TestAgain"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestAgainToErrorMerge" sourceRef="Task_TestAgain" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorMerge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
